title: Forward scan of the eraser
statement: For Boolean words $w$ and $u$ and every integer $j$ with $j\le |u|$, after $j$ steps from the eraser configuration in state $0$ with $u$ on its tape and its head at displacement $0$, the machine remains in state $0$, the tape still contains $u$, and the head is at displacement $j$. The input remains $w$ and the output is empty.
replaced:
For every $j \le \abs{u}$, $j$ steps of the eraser from the start of the
intact word $u$ move its head to displacement $j$, preserving the word and
emitting nothing.
